expectations.text: Knows cub helm install auto-splits CRDs — does not propose manual splitting
expectations.evidence: Lead answer: 'you don't need to — cub helm install already does it.' Creates cert-manager + cert-manager-crds automatically.

expectations.text: Recommends --namespace cert-manager with rationale about chart namespace references
expectations.evidence: Calls out that cert-manager computes .Release.Namespace into webhooks, RBAC subjects, ConfigMap keys.

expectations.text: Confirms --version is pinned (already good) and explains why
expectations.evidence: Notes --version v1.17.2 already pinned, adds: 'Never install without --version.'

expectations.text: Notes cub helm install does NOT accept --change-desc
expectations.evidence: Explicit: 'cub helm install does not accept --change-desc. Chart provenance is recorded as Unit labels.'

expectations.text: Shows correct apply order: CRDs → kubectl wait → main
expectations.evidence: Three-step apply: cub unit apply cert-manager-crds --wait, kubectl wait --for=condition=established, cub unit apply cert-manager --wait.

expectations.text: Provides a verify step using --where Labels.helmrelease
Shows multi-env pattern (clone from base or per-env install)
expectations.evidence: Both Pattern A (per-env install) and Pattern B (clone with --upstream-unit) explained with concrete commands.

expectations.text: Notes that Helm is an onboarding ramp, not the ongoing workflow (config-as-data trajectory)
expectations.evidence: Trajectory section: 'Over time, you'll rely less on chart values and more on cub-mutate functions. The chart is a bootstrap input, not an ongoing parameterization surface.'

expectations.text: Uses valid auth check, not cub info
Hands off apply to cub-apply, customization to cub-mutate
expectations.evidence: Tool boundary section: 'Hand off to cub-apply for deployment. Customizations post-install go through cub-mutate.'
